exit 0
--- stdout
Install selected local Liza toolchain CLIs
Usage:
liza toolchain install [flags]
Flags:
--dry-run print planned install commands without executing them
--exclude stringArray tool id to exclude (repeatable)
-h, --help help for install
--include stringArray tool id to include (repeatable)
--install-dir string directory for managed binaries (default: ~/.local/bin)
--json output result as structured JSON
--profile string tool profile: balanced, lean, or full (default "balanced")
--tool string install only this tool id (needs --yes or --dry-run)
--yes run selected installs without interactive confirmation
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
